raw_segments.text: Oh, I'm only coming in for a minute. I'll keep on my overcoat. Peresven will stay here
in the passage and be dead. I say Peresven, lie down and be dead. You see how he's dead.
I'll go in first and explore, then I'll whistle to him when I think fit, and you'll
see, he'll dash in like mad. Only Smurov must not forget to open the door at the moment.
I'll arrange it all and you'll see something.
